goal: Incremental out-of-sample prediction beyond own prior rebounding rates. Explanation alone is not adoption. No cards, engine edits, simulation or next-layer mechanisms.
label: 四季均已看過答案；回溯資料外診斷，不是新盲測。體測發生年份可核對，歷史發布快照無法保證。

acquisition.source: Official NBA stats API. No name-based/fuzzy IDs, no fabricated values. Public raw mirror permitted only if explicitly documented; mirror-only data remain exploratory and cannot confirm a predictive gain.
acquisition.emptyResponse: Record valid empty rows as empty, not zero coverage of NBA players. Failed requests recorded and not silently dropped.

features.timeRule: Latest available nonmissing NBA-ID-matched combine observation per field with combine year <= origin-season starting year. Never use a target-season performance or target-season body field as a cross-season predictor. Full-season tracking only used as an origin-season predictor for next season, never an early-season predictor of its own later games.
features.zeroRule: Bench repetitions0 is observed0 if explicitly numeric; other body/test quantities must be positive finite. Store missing flags and dates. No strength rating is inferred from mass/OREB/BLK.
forbidden: draft selection or country as talent proxy

association: Four separate seasons, >=500MIN, individual OREB% and OREB/36 versus each observed body/test variable. Pearson/Spearman and n. Descriptive association only, not causal coefficients; no fishing-based feature selection.

prediction.crossSeasonMain: Fit2022-23->2023-24 and2023-24->2024-25; evaluate2024-25->2025-26 once. Both source/target MIN>=100. Outcomes next-season OREB/36 and official OREB_PCT (percentage points). Source MIN<500 and main-team-change groups reported separately; >=500 both seasons sensitivity.
prediction.withinSeason: First20 and first41 positive-minute appearances versus remaining appearances; both portions >=100MIN. Evaluate2023-24 using2022-23 training;2024-25 using2022-23+2023-24;2025-26 using all earlier seasons. Outcome later OREB/36; no full-season advanced/tracking inputs in this task.
prediction.mainTeamChange: Source vs target team with greatest observed minutes differs. Grouping only, never a predictor. This is a portability stress test, not a causal trade effect.

models.persistence: Raw source outcome rate; no fitted slope. For OREB% forecast, source official OREB%.
models.orebPctOnly: Cross-season: own source official OREB% and log1p(source MIN). Within-season: own early OREB/36 and log1p(early MIN).
models.history: Own source outcome rate, log1p(source MIN), plus official source OREB% for cross-season OREB/36 outcome. This stronger baseline prevents claiming gain over a weak OREB%-only comparison.
models.talentOnly: Static + athletic tests + log1p(source MIN); no own rebound history. Diagnostic of explanation and missing/low-sample cases.
models.missingOnly: history + availability flags and years since combine only; negative control for test participation/selection.
models.behavior: talent + behaviorSeparate, cross-season only; must not be described as intrinsic talent.

prediction.estimator: Linear ridge; training-only median imputation plus missingness indicators and standardization. All-missing training columns neutral0 with indicator. Intercept unpenalized. Training weight=min(target MIN,1000); prediction lower clipped0, OREB% capped100; no post-result tuning.

ridge.groupRule: SHA256 of string playerID modulo5, same player stays in same fold across seasons. Select minimum weighted validation MSE; tie choose larger ridge. Training data only.

prediction.metrics: Target-minute-weighted MAE/RMSE for rates; Pearson. Also mean absolute player season-count error using given true target MIN, explicitly conditional exposure, not forecasting minutes. OREB% is a share and is not itself an absolute count.

uncertainty.scheme: Paired target-franchise resampling crossed with player Poisson weights, player/franchise weights matched across seasons and versions. No simulation seeds exist in this offline analysis. This does not replace franchise+simulation-seed acceptance required for future engine adoption; training refit uncertainty excluded.

prediction.interpretation: Confirm only incremental predictive gain against history with a wholly negative paired95 interval. Individual features/within-season/small-sample/mover groups exploratory; no multiplicity-free significance claim. Four seasons already seen; no engine adoption in this batch.

failureRules: Report fetch/schema/ID/coverage failures, complete-case selection and old-test age. If data unavailable, report unavailable rather than manufacture skill or assert no relationship. No post-result feature selection or change to tests.
expected: Physical measurements may help low-sample priors or role transfer; no numerical gain promised. Role/context may dominate and existing OREB% may already subsume physical advantages.
